name: rosetta-caesar-cipher
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

rotate(text: string, key: int) -> string is
    let shifted = System.Text.StringBuilder()

    for letter in text do
        let first =
            if letter >= 'a' /\ letter <= 'z' then cast int('a')
            elif letter >= 'A' /\ letter <= 'Z' then cast int('A')
            else -1
            fi

        if first < 0 then
            shifted.append(letter)
        else
            let rotated = (cast int(letter) - first + key) % 26

            shifted.append(cast char(first + rotated))
        fi
    od

    shifted.to_string()
si

encode(text: string, key: int) -> string => rotate(text, key)
decode(text: string, key: int) -> string => rotate(text, 26 - key)

let message = "The Quick Brown Fox Jumps Over The Lazy Dog!"
let encoded = encode(message, 3)

write_line("plain:   {message}")
write_line("encoded: {encoded}")
write_line("decoded: {decode(encoded, 3)}")
